描述_EN: the two figures, holding branches of coral and lingzhi, or fungus of immortality, are celestial immortal creatures living in the heavens; the single-horned animal depicted below them is a deer, symbol of longevity and often represented with the fungus of immortality in its mouth. the scene depicted on the back of this example combines daoist mythological elements symbolising immortality and good fortune. hand-mirrors with handles were used in ancient china and mentioned in historical texts, but they are less frequent than other types intended to be mounted on stands and placed on dressing tables.
